part3.transcript:
Man: Hi, Claire. Could you help me with the new tax form? I'm not sure how to fill out section three.
Woman: Sure. Section three is about how much tax the company should withhold from your pay. If you tick the first box, we take the standard amount.
Man: Last year too much was taken and I had to wait months for a refund. Is there a way to adjust it?
Woman: Yes. If you and your spouse file a joint return, you can tick the second box and enter her income here. The amount withheld will then be closer to what you actually owe.
Man: That's what I want. Do I need to attach anything?
Woman: Just a copy of last year's return. Leave the form in my tray by Thursday, and the change will apply from next month's pay.
Man: Great, thank you.

questions.prompt: What does the man need help with?
questions.explanation: Người đàn ông hỏi 'Could you help me with the new tax form? I'm not sure how to fill out section three'.

questions.prompt: What problem did the man have last year?
options: Too much tax was taken from his pay
questions.explanation: Anh ấy nói 'Last year too much was taken and I had to wait months for a refund'.

questions.prompt: What should the man do by Thursday?
options: Send a copy to the tax office
Give the form to the woman
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ yêu cầu 'Leave the form in my tray by Thursday'.

part4.transcript: This is a reminder from the Riverton Tax Office. The deadline for filing your personal income tax return is Monday, April 15. Returns received after that date are subject to a penalty of five percent of the amount due, plus one percent for each additional month. If you have never filed online before, we encourage you to try our new website, which does every calculation for you and shows your result immediately. Some people give up when they see the length of the form, so please remember that most sections do not apply to employees with a single job. For help with your preparation, our office at 40 Bridge Street will stay open until eight in the evening every weekday until the deadline, and volunteers will be available to answer questions free of charge. No appointment is necessary. Thank you for listening.

questions.prompt: What is the announcement mainly about?
questions.explanation: Thông báo nhắc 'The deadline for filing your personal income tax return is Monday, April 15' và cách nộp đúng hạn.

questions.prompt: What happens if a return is received after April 15?
questions.explanation: Tờ khai nộp trễ 'are subject to a penalty of five percent of the amount due', tức bị tính tiền phạt.

questions.prompt: What is said about the office on Bridge Street?
options: It offers free help in the evening
questions.explanation: Văn phòng mở đến tám giờ tối các ngày trong tuần và tình nguyện viên trả lời câu hỏi 'free of charge'; không cần đặt hẹn.

part5.prompt: Please double-check every _____ before you send the report to the tax office.
part5.explanation: Sau 'every' cần danh từ số ít: 'calculation' (phép tính).

part5.prompt: The company still _____ the city nearly four thousand dollars in property tax.
part5.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'The company' số ít ở thì hiện tại đơn nên động từ thêm -s: 'owes'.

part5.prompt: Employers are required to _____ a portion of each salary for income tax.
part5.explanation: Sau 'required to' cần động từ nguyên mẫu: 'withhold' (khấu lưu).

part5.prompt: Careful _____ of your receipts will make the tax appointment shorter.
part5.explanation: Sau tính từ 'Careful' và trước 'of' cần danh từ làm chủ ngữ: 'preparation'.

part5.prompt: The two companies made a _____ request for an extension of the deadline.
part5.explanation: Trước danh từ 'request' cần tính từ: 'joint' (chung của hai công ty).

part5.prompt: Customers who return a damaged product will receive a full _____ within ten days.
part5.explanation: Sau 'a full' cần danh từ: 'refund' (khoản hoàn tiền).

Employees who changed jobs or started a second job during the year must ___ Form T-12, which is available from the payroll office. The tax authority applies a ___ to any return received after April 15, so we strongly recommend that you prepare your documents well before the ___. For questions, call Mr. Keller at extension 412.

questions.explanation: Với một mẫu đơn (Form T-12), động từ phù hợp là 'fill out' (điền vào).
Sau 'applies a' cần danh từ: 'penalty' (tiền phạt) cho tờ khai nộp trễ.
Sau 'before the' cần danh từ số ít chỉ mốc thời gian đã nêu (April 15): 'deadline'.

part7.passage:
Northfield Regional Tax Office
Taxpayer Services, 112 Linden Avenue

June 3

Dear Ms. Dubois,

Thank you for filing your income tax return for last year. We have reviewed the figures you submitted together with the statements sent by your employer.

Our calculation shows that your employer withheld 6,140 dollars during the year, while the tax you owe is 5,710 dollars. You are therefore entitled to a refund of 430 dollars. The amount will be transferred to the bank account listed on your return within fourteen days of the date of this letter.

Please note two points for next year. First, you indicated that you were married in October, so you and your spouse may choose to file a joint return, which often results in a lower total tax. Second, the deadline for next year's return is April 15. Returns filed after that date are subject to a penalty, even when a refund is expected.

If you believe any figure in this letter is incorrect, you may request a review by filling out Form R-2 and returning it to this office within 30 days.

Sincerely,
Henry Ashford
Taxpayer Services

options: To explain the result of a tax return
To announce a new tax rate
To confirm a change of address
questions.explanation: Thư thông báo kết quả xem xét tờ khai thuế: số tiền đã khấu lưu, số thuế phải nộp và khoản hoàn lại.

questions.prompt: How much will Ms. Dubois receive?
questions.explanation: 'You are therefore entitled to a refund of 430 dollars.' 6,140 là số đã khấu lưu, 5,710 là số thuế phải nộp.
Thư ghi 'you indicated that you were married in October'.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about joint returns?
options: They must be filed in October
They can reduce the tax paid
They are required for married couples
questions.explanation: Khai chung 'often results in a lower total tax'; đây là lựa chọn ('may choose'), không bắt buộc.

questions.prompt: What should Ms. Dubois do if she disagrees with a figure?
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối: 'request a review by filling out Form R-2 and returning it to this office within 30 days'.
